newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks gain, techs resume rise.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks gain, techs resume rise.

text.p: U.S. stocks rose in morning trade as Wednesday as bonds firmed and as technology stocks, recent leaders, extended gains while digesting news Microsoft Corp MFST.O would invest in Apple Computer Inc.
The Dow Jones Industrial average, which opened lower, reversed to rise 35 points, trading at 8222.

The Nasdaq composite index also turned around, gaining six points to trade at 1628. Among technology shares, Apple surged over five points to 25-3/8 after Microsoft Corp said it would invest $150 million in the computer maker.
